title: Yellowed Russian Beef Pilaf
description: A hearty, peppery Russian dish featuring grana-padano and lamination-puff, cooked to perfection on a salt-block vessel.
instructions: Preheat the salt-block vessel to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Roll out the lamination-puff pastry to a large sheet, about 1/4 inch thick.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium-high heat and cook the beef strips until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped onion and minced garlic to the skillet and cook until the onion is translucent, about 3 minutes.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked beef and onion mixture, shredded grana-padano cheese, and black pepper.
Place the pastry sheet on the preheated salt-block vessel and spoon the beef and cheese mixture onto one half of the pastry, leaving a 1/2 inch border around the edges.
Fold the other half of the pastry over the filling and press the edges to seal.
Brush the pastry with olive oil and cut a few slits in the top to allow steam to escape.
Bake the pilaf for 25 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown and puffed.
Remove the pilaf from the oven and let it rest for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.
